p: Powis Street has been Woolwich's main shopping street for well over a century, running from Beresford Square and General Gordon Square towards the river. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre and 18+ only.

Woolwich has transformed in recent years. The old Royal Arsenal site by the Thames has been turned into homes, bars, restaurants and riverside walks, and it's well worth a wander to see the historic buildings. The free Woolwich Ferry still crosses the river to North Woolwich, and the Thames Barrier is a short walk west along the Thames Path. With the Elizabeth line now stopping at Woolwich, central London and Canary Wharf are a quick ride away.
